prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin to establish rules on which kinds of change work or fail, as each kind of change has only one test so far.
Predictions were consistently too high for failed tests: [adoption, redesign] (predicted +14.0%, actual -7.7%), [sign_in, reorder] (predicted +6.0%, actual -7.6%), and [finish, new_screen] (predicted +4.0%, actual -6.4%) all yielded negative results.
Predictions were too low for winning tests: [finish, redesign] exceeded expectations (predicted +3.0%, actual +5.2%).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -7.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -6.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: +5.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -7.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 69.7%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.2%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Generation Status and Tips Screen: Insert a new status screen during pet asset generation that displays rendering progress alongside helpful customization tips. (why: Adoption has a low conversion (60.9%) and support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Stage-Based Pet Adoption Selection: Redesign the pet selection screen into a stage layout featuring animated mascot previews and highlight badges. (why: Adoption conversion is 60.9% with a long mean duration of 1017s, indicating difficulty in selecting a pet.)
2: [finish, redesign] Desktop Visibility Checklist and Launch Setup: Redesign the final step into a checklist format confirming desktop display permissions and pet visibility controls. (why: Support received 3 emails reporting pets not showing on the desktop, and completion drops to 69.7%.)
3: [sign_in, new_flow] Account Recovery and Sync Status Banner: Add an explicit Cloud Pet Recovery badge and status callout on the sign-in screen to assure returning users their pet data is restored. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing back into an account.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Assets Loading Progress Indicator: Enhance the waiting screen with real-time status steps showing graphics loading and desktop integration progress. (why: The waiting step has an 81.3% conversion and long mean wait time (2336s), leading to user drop-off.)
5: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Quick Command Summary: Update the home intro text with clear guidance on shortcuts for summoning, hiding, and interacting with the desktop pet. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after finishing setup.)
6: [sign_in, layout] Centered Single-Click Account Sign In: Reorganize the sign-in layout into a centered card view with explicit cloud sync badges. (why: Sign in drops 27.1% of users (72.9% conversion) with a mean time of 567s.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Carousel Path Selection Experience: Switch path selection to a carousel layout comparing quick adoption versus custom pet creation side-by-side. (why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path with a mean duration of 514s.)
